build_llm_ensemble: build an LLM ensemble from a list of model configs with normalized weights
generate_text_weighted: generate text by sampling a model from the ensemble based on weights
generate_with_context: generate text using a system message and conversational context from a sampled model
generate_multiple_parallel: generate multiple responses for the same prompt in parallel using the ensemble
generate_all_models_context: generate responses from all models in the ensemble using system message and context
